description: Operating kit for planner-led work: /kimiflow init sets up project rules, handoff, list and plan templates; plus delivery support elsewhere.

interface.shortDescription: Operating kit and delivery support using native agent tools
interface.longDescription: An operating kit for planner-led work: init sets up project rules, worker rules, a handoff, one list and plan templates in .kimiflow/ops/; update compares them with newer templates. Elsewhere a short working agreement with project-native verification applies. Uses the selected model and host tools. In Codex: skill texts only, no hooks or agents; no managed engine, memory platform, fleet or automatic provider routing. Development-era managed runs require their original runtime; see compatibility notes.
defaultPrompt: Use Kimiflow to implement this task and verify the result
